text: We are considering the user cell phone as a transmitter. So we are considering that there is an application that generates data and generates packets. Those are application layer packets. These application layer packets are sent down through different functions that are called layers. Till they reach the MAC layer. If we are using Wi-Fi, the MAC layer, as we will explain better later, tells when a packet can be transmitted. When the MAC of Wi-Fi says the packet can be transmitted, then the packet is sent to the physical layer, where we perform, for example, modulation. And then we transmit the electromagnetic wave through the antenna. The antenna travels through the air, it reaches the antenna of the access point. It is received. We perform demodulation, that means we extract the bits. And then we group them into a packet that is sent to the MAC layer of the access point.
